english_text: Community education reduces TB stigma and encourages people to seek care.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea sechaba e fokotsa kekello ea TB le ho khothaletsa batho ho batla tlhokomelo.

english_text: TB survivors can play a powerful role in reducing stigma in their communities.
sesotho_text: Baphonyohi ba TB ba ka bua karolo e matla ho fokotsa kekello sechabeng sa bona.

english_text: Mental health support should be integrated into TB care services.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea bophelo ba kelello e lokela ho kopanyoa le litshebeletso tsa tlhokomelo ea TB.

english_text: Depression is common among TB patients and can negatively affect treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho nyamela ho atile ho bakuli ba TB mme ho ka angoa ho latela phekolo ka tsela e mpe.

english_text: Peer support groups help TB patients stay motivated and complete their treatment.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea bahlankana li thusa bakuli ba TB ho lula ba khothalitsoe le ho phetela phekolo ea bona.

english_text: Disclosing your TB diagnosis to trusted family members can help you get the support you need.
sesotho_text: Ho senola tlhahlobo ea TB ea hau ho maloko a lelapa a tšepahalang ho ka u thusa ho fumana tshehetso eo u e hlokang.

english_text: Social protection measures such as food vouchers help TB patients stay on treatment.
sesotho_text: Mehato ea tšireletso ea sechaba joalo ka li-voucher tsa lijo e thusa bakuli ba TB ho lula holim'a phekolo.

english_text: Transport support for clinic visits reduces missed appointments among TB patients.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea lipalangoa bakeng sa litsebeliso tsa kliniki e fokotsa meeto e lahlehileng ho bakuli ba TB.

english_text: Tuberculosis is one of the top ten causes of death worldwide.
sesotho_text: Tuberculosis ke e 'ngoe ea mabaka a leshome a phahameng ka ho fetisisa a lefu lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: The WHO End TB Strategy aims to reduce TB deaths by 95 percent by 2035.
sesotho_text: Leano la WHO la ho Felisa TB le ikemiseditse ho fokotsa lifu tsa TB ka pesente ea 95 ka 2035.

english_text: Achieving the End TB targets requires addressing poverty, malnutrition, and social determinants.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlela lipheo tsa ho Felisa TB ho hloka ho sebetsana le bofuma, ho hloka phepo, le lintlha tsa sechaba.

english_text: TB notification rates have been declining globally but progress is too slow.
sesotho_text: Likhato tsa ho tsebisa TB li theohile lefatšeng lohle empa tsoelo-pele e lieha haholo.

english_text: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted TB services and set back progress against tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Lefu la COVID-19 le phephetse litshebeletso tsa TB mme la khutlisa tsoelo-pele khahlanong le tuberculosis.

english_text: Investing in TB research and new diagnostics is critical to ending the epidemic.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahisa lichelete lipatlisisong tsa TB le litlhahlobo tse ncha ho bohlokoa ho felisa leruo la lefu.

english_text: Community health workers are essential to reaching TB patients in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba bohlokoa ho fihlela bakuli ba TB libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Digital health tools such as SMS reminders can improve TB treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa bophelo bo botle tsa dijithale joalo ka litemoso tsa SMS li ka ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Universal health coverage is fundamental to ending tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Koahelo ea bophelo bo botle ea bohle ke motheo oa ho felisa tuberculosis.

english_text: I was scared when I was told I had tuberculosis, but my nurse explained everything clearly.
sesotho_text: Ke ne ke tšaba ha ke bolelloa hore ke na le tuberculosis, empa mooki oa ka o hlalositsa ntho tsohle ka boqaqo.

english_text: Taking six months of tablets every day was difficult, but I finished my treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho nka lipilisi letsatsi le leng le le leng ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng e ne e le thata, empa ke pheteletse phekolo ea ka.

english_text: My family supported me throughout my TB treatment and I am grateful.
sesotho_text: Lelapa la ka le ntshehetse nako yohle ea phekolo ea TB ea ka mme ke leboha.

english_text: I lost my job because people at work were afraid of catching TB from me.
sesotho_text: Ke lahleheloe ke mosebetsi hobane batho mosebetsing ba ne ba tšaba ho tšoaetsoa TB ke nna.

english_text: After two weeks on treatment I started feeling much better and could sleep through the night.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a libeke tse peli holim'a phekolo ke qalile ho ikutloa ke ntlafetse haholo mme ka khona ho robala bosiu bohle.

english_text: I now tell everyone in my community to go and get tested if they have a cough.
sesotho_text: Joale ke bolella bohle sechabeng sa ka ho ea ho hlahlobeloa haeba ba na le ho kohoa.

english_text: The community health worker visited me at home every day to make sure I took my tablets.
sesotho_text: Mosebetsi oa bophelo bo botle oa sechaba o ne a etela lapeng letsatsi le leng le le leng ho netefatsa hore ke nka lipilisi tsa ka.

english_text: I was relieved when my sputum test came back negative after two months of treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke khotsofetse ha tlhahlobo ea mathe ea ka e khutlile e senyenyane ka mor'a likhoeli tse peli tsa phekolo.

english_text: Having TB and HIV at the same time was overwhelming, but the clinic team helped me cope.
sesotho_text: Ho ba le TB le HIV ka nako e le ngoe e ne e le thata haholo, empa sehlopha sa kliniki se nthusitse ho mamella.

english_text: I am now cured of tuberculosis and I feel stronger than ever before.
sesotho_text: Joale ke folisitsoe tuberculosis mme ke ikutloa ke matla ho feta nako efe kafe pele.

english_text: TB patients should sleep in a well-ventilated room, separate from other household members if possible.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho robala kamoreng e nang le moea o lekaneng, e arohaneng le maloko a mang a lelapa haeba ho khoneha.

english_text: Infectious TB patients should avoid crowded public spaces during the first two weeks of treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba fetisoang ba lokela ho hana libaka tsa sechaba tse tletse batho nakong ea libeke tse peli tsa pele tsa phekolo.

english_text: After two weeks of effective treatment, most TB patients are no longer infectious.
sesotho_text: Ka mor'a libeke tse peli tsa phekolo e sebetsang, bakuli ba bangata ba TB ha ba sa fetiseloe.

english_text: TB infection control in health facilities protects both patients and healthcare workers.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB likamoreng tsa bophelo bo botle e sireletsa bakuli le basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Administrative controls such as fast-tracking TB patients reduce exposure in waiting areas.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tsamaiso joalo ka ho potlakisa bakuli ba TB e fokotsa ho hlahisoa libakeng tsa ho ema.

english_text: Environmental controls like natural ventilation are the most cost-effective TB infection control measure.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tikoloho joalo ka moea oa tlhaho ke mohato o sebetsang ka ho fetisisa oa taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB ho latela litšenyehelo.

english_text: Respiratory protection for healthcare workers is the last line of defence against TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea ho hema bakeng sa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ke mola oa ho qetela oa tšireletso khahlanong le phetisetso ea TB.

english_text: Cough etiquette posters in clinic waiting rooms remind patients to cover their mouths.
sesotho_text: Liforomo tsa mokhoa oa ho kohoa likamoreng tsa ho ema tsa kliniki li khumamisa bakuli ho khupetsa melumo ea bona.

english_text: Sputum collection should be done outdoors or in a well-ventilated area to reduce transmission risk.
sesotho_text: Ho kgotha mathe ho lokela ho etsoa kantle kapa sebakeng se nang le moea o lekaneng ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso.

english_text: TB triage at clinic entry helps identify and separate potentially infectious patients quickly.
sesotho_text: Triage ea TB ha ho kenoa klinikhing e thusa ho tseba le ho arola bakuli ba ka fetisoang ka potlako.

english_text: Sputum smear microscopy at two months confirms whether treatment is working.
sesotho_text: Microscopy ea ho hlakola mathe ka likhoeli tse peli e netefatsa hore na phekolo e sebetsa.

english_text: A positive sputum culture at three months may indicate treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe e molemo ka likhoeli tse tharo e ka bontša ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Monthly clinic visits during TB treatment allow the doctor to monitor your progress.
sesotho_text: Litsebeliso tsa kliniki tsa khoeli le khoeli nakong ea phekolo ea TB li lumella ngaka ho hlahloja tsoelo-pele ea hau.

english_text: Weight gain during TB treatment is a positive sign that the medicines are working.
sesotho_text: Ho eketseha ha boima nakong ea phekolo ea TB ke letšoao le molemo la hore meriana e sebetsa.

english_text: End-of-treatment sputum culture confirms successful cure for drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe ea qetelo ea phekolo e netefatsa pholo e atlehileng bakeng sa TB e khakanyeng meriana.

english_text: Post-treatment follow-up helps detect TB relapse early.
sesotho_text: Ho latela ka mor'a phekolo ho thusa ho fumana ho khutlela morao ha TB kapele.

english_text: TB relapse can occur months or years after completing treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho khutlela morao ha TB ho ka etsahala likhoeli kapa lilemo ka mor'a ho phetela phekolo.

english_text: Report any new symptoms after completing TB treatment to your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mofani oa hau oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle matšoao afe kafe a mocha ka mor'a ho phetela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Liver function tests should be monitored regularly during TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa tšebetso ea sebete li lokela ho hlahlojoa ka mehla nakong ea phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Vision testing should be done before and during ethambutol treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha pono ho lokela ho etsoa pele le nakong ea phekolo ea ethambutol.

english_text: TB is a notifiable disease; all cases must be reported to the national health authorities.
sesotho_text: TB ke bolwetse bo tsebisahalang; liketsahalo tsohle li lokela ho tsebisoa mabusetong a bophelo bo botle a naha.

english_text: The National Strategic Plan guides South Africa's response to tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Leano la Naha la Leano le etelela karabelo ea Afrika Boroa ho tuberculosis.

english_text: Community-based TB care reduces the burden on health facilities and improves patient outcomes.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea TB e thehiloeng sechabeng e fokotsa morwalo oa likamore tsa bophelo bo botle le ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bakuli.

english_text: Task-shifting allows community health workers to support TB treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho fetisetsa mesebetsi e fapaneng ho lumella basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ho tshehetsa ho latela phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Electronic TB registers improve data quality and programme monitoring.
sesotho_text: Lirejista tsa TB tsa elektroniki li ntlafatsa boleng ba data le ho hlahloja lenaneo.

english_text: The treatment success rate is the key indicator of TB programme performance.
sesotho_text: Khato ea katleho ea phekolo ke sesupo se bohlokoa sa tšebetso ea lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Loss to follow-up remains a major challenge in achieving high TB treatment success rates.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela ho ntse ho le mathata a maholo ho fihlela likhato tse phahameng tsa katleho ea phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Tracing patients lost to follow-up is an essential part of TB programme management.
sesotho_text: Ho latela bakuli ba lahlehetseng ho latela ke karolo ea bohlokoa ea taolo ea lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Public-private partnerships expand access to TB diagnosis and treatment services.
sesotho_text: Likoporasi tsa sechaba le tsa poraefete li atolosa phihlello ea litshebeletso tsa tlhahlobo le phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Adequate funding for TB programmes is essential to achieving elimination targets.
sesotho_text: Lichelete tse lekaneng bakeng sa mananeo a TB li bohlokoa ho fihlela lipheo tsa ho felisa bolwetse.

english_text: Tuberculosis has affected humanity for thousands of years and remains a global health challenge.
sesotho_text: Tuberculosis e angoe batho ka lilemo tse likete mme e ntse e le mathata a bophelo bo botle a lefatše lohle.

english_text: Robert Koch discovered the bacterium that causes tuberculosis in 1882.
sesotho_text: Robert Koch o fumane bakteria e bakoang ke tuberculosis ka 1882.

english_text: Mycobacterium tuberculosis is the scientific name of the bacterium that causes TB.
sesotho_text: Mycobacterium tuberculosis ke lebitso la saense la bakteria e bakoang ke TB.

english_text: TB bacteria can survive in the air for several hours in poorly ventilated spaces.
sesotho_text: Bakteria ea TB e ka phela moeeng ka maho a mang libakeng tse se nang moea o lekaneng.

english_text: Not everyone exposed to TB bacteria will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Ha se batho bohle ba hlahisitsoeng bakteria ea TB ba tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: The immune system can contain TB bacteria in an inactive state called latent TB.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea 'mele e ka laola bakteria ea TB boemong bo sa sebetseng bo bitsoa TB e patileng.

english_text: Approximately one quarter of the world's population has latent TB infection.
sesotho_text: E ka bang karolo e 'ngoe ho tse nne tsa baahi ba lefatše e na le tšoaetso ea TB e patileng.

english_text: Only about five to ten percent of people with latent TB will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Batho ba mahlano ho isa ho leshome feela ho pesente ba nang le TB e patileng ba tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: World TB Day is observed on March 24th each year to raise awareness about tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Letsatsi la Lefatše la TB le phethoa ka la 24 Hlakubele selemo le selemo ho eketsa tsebo ka tuberculosis.

english_text: The theme of World TB Day reflects the global commitment to ending tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Sehlooho sa Letsatsi la Lefatše la TB se bontša boikarabello ba lefatše lohle ba ho felisa tuberculosis.

english_text: TB affects people of all ages, genders, and socioeconomic backgrounds.
sesotho_text: TB e angoa batho ba lilemo tsohle, bong bohle, le maemo ohle a moruo oa sechaba.

english_text: Men are more likely than women to develop active tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Banna ba na le monyetla o moholo ho feta basali oa ho ba le tuberculosis e sebetsang.

english_text: Young adults aged 15 to 44 bear a disproportionate share of the global TB burden.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba bacha ba lilemo tse 15 ho isa ho 44 ba rwala karolo e sa lekanang ea morwalo oa TB oa lefatše lohle.

english_text: TB can cause permanent lung damage if not treated promptly and completely.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka kotsi ea matšoafo e sa foleng haeba e sa phekoluoe ka potlako le ka botlalo.

english_text: Tuberculous meningitis is a life-threatening form of TB that affects the brain.
sesotho_text: TB meningitis ke mofuta oa TB o kotsi ea bophelo o angoa boko.

english_text: Spinal TB, also known as Pott's disease, can cause back pain and spinal deformity.
sesotho_text: TB ea mokokotlo, e tsebahala hape e le bolwetse ba Pott, e ka baka mahloko a mokokotlo le ho senyeha ha mokokotlo.

english_text: Abdominal TB can cause pain, swelling, and digestive problems.
sesotho_text: TB ea mpa e ka baka mahloko, ho ruruha, le mathata a ho kena ha lijo.

english_text: TB of the lymph nodes is the most common form of extrapulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: TB ea li-lymph node ke mofuta o atileng ka ho fetisisa oa tuberculosis ea kantle ho matšoafo.

english_text: Miliary TB is a severe form where TB bacteria spread through the bloodstream to multiple organs.
sesotho_text: TB ea miliary ke mofuta o matla moo bakteria ea TB e phatlalatsang ka mali ho ea litho tse ngata.

english_text: With proper treatment, the vast majority of people with TB can be completely cured.
sesotho_text: Ka phekolo e nepahetseng, boholo ba batho ba nang le TB ba ka folisoa ka botlalo.

english_text: TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or speaks.
sesotho_text: TB e phatlalala ka moea ha motho ea tšoaetsoeng a kohoa, a thimola, kapa a bua.

english_text: You cannot get TB from sharing cups, plates, or cutlery with an infected person.
sesotho_text: Ha u khone ho fumana TB ka ho arolelana likomoki, lisele, kapa lisebelisoa tsa lijo le motho ea tšoaetsoeng.

english_text: You cannot get TB from shaking hands or touching surfaces.
sesotho_text: Ha u khone ho fumana TB ka ho tobana ka matsoho kapa ho ama likaroloana.

english_text: Prolonged close contact with an infectious TB patient increases the risk of transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho kopana haufi nako e telele le mokuloi oa TB ea fetisoang ho eketsa kotsi ea phetisetso.

english_text: TB transmission is more likely indoors than outdoors due to poor air circulation.
sesotho_text: Phetisetso ea TB e atile haholo ka hare ho ntlo ho feta kantle ka lebaka la ho potoloha ha moea ho fokolang.

english_text: A single infectious TB patient can infect 10 to 15 people per year if untreated.
sesotho_text: Mokuloi o le mong oa TB ea fetisoang a ka tšoaetsa batho ba 10 ho isa ho 15 selemo le selemo haeba a sa phekoluoe.

english_text: Singing and shouting can release more TB particles into the air than normal breathing.
sesotho_text: Ho bina le ho howa ho ka lokolla likaroloana tse ngata tsa TB moeeng ho feta ho hema ha kamehla.

english_text: TB is not spread through blood, sexual contact, or insect bites.
sesotho_text: TB ha e phatlalatsoe ka mali, kopano ea thobalano, kapa ho lometsooa ke likhokahane.

english_text: Bovine TB can be transmitted to humans through unpasteurised milk from infected cattle.
sesotho_text: TB ea likhomo e ka fetiseloa ho batho ka lebese le sa phethisoang ho tsoa ho likhomo tse tšoaetsoeng.

english_text: Pasteurising milk kills Mycobacterium bovis and prevents bovine TB transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho phethisa lebese ho bolaea Mycobacterium bovis le ho thibela phetisetso ea TB ea likhomo.

english_text: TB screening involves checking for symptoms, risk factors, and sometimes a chest X-ray.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho kenyelletsa ho hlahloba matšoao, lintlha tsa kotsi, le nako tse itseng X-ray ea sefuba.

english_text: Mass TB screening in high-burden communities helps find undiagnosed cases.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ka bongata sechabeng se nang le morwalo o moholo ho thusa ho fumana liketsahalo tse sa fumanoe.

english_text: Active case finding brings TB testing directly to communities rather than waiting for patients to present.
sesotho_text: Ho batla liketsahalo tse sebetsang ho tlisa liteko tsa TB ka kotloloho sechabeng ho feta ho ema bakuli ba tle.

english_text: Mobile X-ray units allow TB screening to reach remote and underserved populations.
sesotho_text: Liqenehelo tsa X-ray tse tsamaelang li lumella ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho fihlela sechaba se hole le se sa sebelisoeng hantle.

english_text: Systematic TB screening in prisons reduces transmission within correctional facilities.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ka mokhoa o reriloeng likotsofatsong ho fokotsa phetisetso likamoreng tsa ho loka.

english_text: Workplace TB screening programmes protect employees and reduce absenteeism.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho hlahlobeloa ha TB mafapheng a mosebetsi a sireletsa basebetsi le ho fokotsa ho hloka mosebetsi.

english_text: TB screening at entry points such as borders helps identify cases in migrant populations.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB meeling ea ho kenela joalo ka meeling ea linaha ho thusa ho tseba liketsahalo ho sechaba sa baahi ba fetang.

english_text: School-based TB screening can identify cases among adolescents and their household contacts.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho thehiloeng sekolong ho ka tseba liketsahalo ho bacha le bakopani ba bona ba lelapa.

english_text: People with symptoms of TB should not wait — seek testing at your nearest clinic today.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le matšoao a TB ha ba lokela ho ema — batla liteko klinikhing ea hau e haufi kajeno.

english_text: Free TB testing is available at all public health clinics in South Africa.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ha ho lefisoe ho fumaneha likhlinikhing tsohle tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba Afrika Boroa.

english_text: Rifampicin is one of the most important drugs in the treatment of tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin ke e 'ngoe ea meriana e bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ho phekolo ea tuberculosis.

english_text: Isoniazid has been used to treat tuberculosis since the 1950s.
sesotho_text: Isoniazid e sebelisitsoe ho phekola tuberculosis ho tloha lilemong tsa bo-1950.

english_text: Pyrazinamide is most effective during the first two months of TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Pyrazinamide e sebetsa hantle ka ho fetisisa nakong ea likhoeli tse peli tsa pele tsa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Ethambutol prevents the development of resistance to other TB drugs.
sesotho_text: Ethambutol e thibela ho hlaha ha khakanyo ho meriana e meng ea TB.

english_text: Streptomycin was the first antibiotic found to be effective against tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Streptomycin e ne e le antibiotic ea pele e fumaneoang e sebetsa khahlanong le tuberculosis.

english_text: Second-line TB drugs are used when first-line drugs cannot be used due to resistance or side effects.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea mola oa bobeli ea TB e sebelisoa ha meriana ea mola oa pele e ke ke ea sebelisoa ka lebaka la khakanyo kapa litlamorao.

english_text: Fluoroquinolones such as levofloxacin and moxifloxacin are key drugs for MDR-TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Li-fluoroquinolone joalo ka levofloxacin le moxifloxacin ke meriana ea bohlokoa bakeng sa phekolo ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Clofazimine is used in combination regimens for drug-resistant tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Clofazimine e sebelisoa mananeo a kopano bakeng sa tuberculosis e khakanyeng meriana.

english_text: Linezolid is an effective but potentially toxic drug used in highly resistant TB regimens.
sesotho_text: Linezolid ke moriana o sebetsang empa o ka kotsi o sebelisoa mananeo a TB e khakanyeng haholo.

english_text: Pretomanid is a newer TB drug approved for use in combination with bedaquiline and linezolid.
sesotho_text: Pretomanid ke moriana o mocha oa TB o amohetsoeng ho sebelisoa kopanong le bedaquiline le linezolid.

english_text: Sputum culture is the gold standard for confirming a TB diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Culture ea mathe ke sesupo sa tšimong sa ho netefatsa tlhahlobo ea TB.

english_text: TB cultures can take up to eight weeks to grow in a laboratory.
sesotho_text: Li-culture tsa TB li ka nka ho fihla libeke tse robeli ho hola laboratoreng.

english_text: Liquid culture media such as MGIT give faster results than solid media.
sesotho_text: Mecha ea culture ea metsi joalo ka MGIT e fana ka liphetho tse potlakileng ho feta mecha e thata.

english_text: Line probe assays can rapidly detect resistance to isoniazid and rifampicin.
sesotho_text: Li-assay tsa line probe li ka fumana kapele khakanyo ea isoniazid le rifampicin.

english_text: Whole genome sequencing provides the most detailed picture of TB drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho latelana ha genome yohle ho fana ka setšoantšo se pharalletseng ka ho fetisisa sa khakanyo ea meriana ea TB.

english_text: Urine lipoarabinomannan testing helps diagnose TB in people living with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha lipoarabinomannan ea moroto ho thusa ho fumana TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Stool-based TB testing is being developed for children who cannot produce sputum.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha TB ho thehiloeng holim'a manyolo ho ntšoa bakeng sa bana ba ke ke ba hlahisa mathe.

english_text: Artificial intelligence tools are being developed to read chest X-rays for TB screening.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa kelello ea maiketsetso li ntšoa ho bala li-X-ray tsa sefuba bakeng sa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB.

english_text: Point-of-care TB diagnostics bring testing closer to patients in remote settings.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa TB tsa sebaka sa tlhokomelo li tlisa liteko haufi le bakuli libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Rapid TB diagnostics reduce the time between symptom onset and treatment start.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa TB tsa potlako li fokotsa nako lipakeng tsa ho qala ha matšoao le ho qala ha phekolo.

english_text: Kidney disease can affect how TB drugs are processed and may require dose adjustments.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba lipitso bo ka angoa hore na meriana ea TB e sebetsoa joang mme bo ka hloka ho fetola li-dose.

english_text: Liver disease complicates TB treatment because most TB drugs are processed by the liver.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba sebete bo noa phekolo ea TB hobane meriana e mengata ea TB e sebetsoa ke sebete.

english_text: People with TB and liver disease need close monitoring of liver function tests.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le TB le bolwetse ba sebete ba hloka ho hlahlojoa ka hloko ha liteko tsa tšebetso ea sebete.

english_text: Malnutrition impairs the immune response and increases the risk of TB treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka phepo ho khathatsa karabelo ea tšireletso ea 'mele le ho eketsa kotsi ea ho hloleha ha phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Anaemia is common in TB patients and should be assessed and treated.
sesotho_text: Anaemia e atile ho bakuli ba TB mme e lokela ho hlahlojoa le ho phekoluoa.

english_text: TB can worsen blood sugar control in people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: TB e ka mpe taolo ea tsoekere ea mali ho batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: People with TB and diabetes should monitor their blood sugar more frequently.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le TB le tsoekere ba lokela ho hlahloja tsoekere ea bona ea mali hangata haholo.

english_text: Steroid therapy is recommended for TB meningitis and pericarditis.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea steroid e khothalletsoa bakeng sa TB meningitis le pericarditis.

english_text: TB can cause pleural effusion, a build-up of fluid around the lungs.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka pleural effusion, ho bokana ha metsi haufi le matšoafo.

english_text: TB pericarditis affects the sac surrounding the heart and requires prompt treatment.
sesotho_text: TB pericarditis e angoa saka e potileng pelo mme e hloka phekolo ea potlako.

english_text: Every person with TB has the right to dignified, respectful, and confidential care.
sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong ea nang le TB o na le tokelo ea tlhokomelo e nang le seriti, hlompho, le sephiri.

english_text: TB patients have the right to be informed about their diagnosis and treatment options.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba na le tokelo ea ho tsebisoa ka tlhahlobo ea bona le likhetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Employers cannot legally dismiss an employee solely because they have tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Bafani ba mosebetsi ha ba khone ho leleka mosebetsi ka molao ka lebaka la hore a na le tuberculosis feela.

english_text: TB patients who cannot work during treatment may be eligible for social grants.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba ke ke ba sebetsa nakong ea phekolo ba ka ba le tokelo ea lithuso tsa sechaba.

english_text: Confidentiality of TB diagnosis must be maintained by all healthcare providers.
sesotho_text: Sephiri sa tlhahlobo ea TB se lokela ho bolokoa ke bafani bohle ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Patients have the right to refuse treatment, but the consequences should be clearly explained.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba na le tokelo ea ho hana phekolo, empa litlamorao li lokela ho hlalossoa ka boqaqo.

english_text: Children with TB have the right to continue their education during treatment.
sesotho_text: Bana ba nang le TB ba na le tokelo ea ho tsoela pele thuto ea bona nakong ea phekolo.

english_text: TB patients should be treated with compassion and without judgment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho phekoluoa ka kutloisiso le ntle le ho ahlola.

english_text: Involving patients in decisions about their care improves treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa bakuli liqetong mabapi le tlhokomelo ea bona ho ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo.

english_text: Patient support groups provide a safe space for TB patients to share their experiences.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea bakuli li fana ka sebaka se bolokehileng bakeng sa bakuli ba TB ho arolelana maiphihlelo a bona.

english_text: New TB vaccines are currently being tested in clinical trials around the world.
sesotho_text: Liente tse ncha tsa TB li sa ntse li lekoa lihlahlobong tsa kliniki lefatšeng lohle joale.

english_text: The M72 candidate vaccine showed promising results in a Phase 2b clinical trial.
sesotho_text: Ente ea M72 e bontšitse liphetho tse tšepehang tlhahlobong ea kliniki ea Phase 2b.

english_text: Shorter TB treatment regimens would improve adherence and reduce the burden on patients.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a khutšoanyane a phekolo ea TB a ka ntlafatsa ho latela le ho fokotsa morwalo ho bakuli.

english_text: The STREAM trial evaluated shorter regimens for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea STREAM e ile ea lekola mananeo a khutšoanyane bakeng sa tuberculosis e khakanyeng meriana e mengata.

english_text: Host-directed therapies aim to boost the immune response against TB bacteria.
sesotho_text: Diphekolo tse lebisitsoeng ho motho e ikemiseditse ho matlafatsa karabelo ea tšireletso ea 'mele khahlanong le bakteria ea TB.

english_text: Repurposed drugs from other disease areas are being tested for TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Meriana e fetohileng morero ho tsoa libakeng tse ling tsa bolwetse e lekoa bakeng sa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: TB biomarkers in blood could help predict who will develop active disease.
sesotho_text: Li-biomarker tsa TB maline li ka thusa ho bolela pele hore na ke mang ea tla ba le bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: Improved TB diagnostics are needed to detect all forms of the disease accurately.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tse ntlafetse tsa TB li hlokeha ho fumana mefuta yohle ea bolwetse ka nepo.

english_text: Community engagement in TB research ensures studies are relevant to affected populations.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa sechaba lipatlisisong tsa TB ho netefatsa hore lipatlisiso li amahanngoa le sechaba se angoa.

english_text: Open access to TB research data accelerates the development of new tools and treatments.
sesotho_text: Phihlello e bulehileng ho data ea lipatlisiso tsa TB e potlakisa ntlafatso ea lisebelisoa le diphekolo tse ncha.

english_text: The treatment success rate for drug-sensitive TB in South Africa has been improving.
sesotho_text: Khato ea katleho ea phekolo bakeng sa TB e amehang ke meriana Afrika Boroa e ntse e ntlafala.

english_text: TB programme data should be reviewed regularly to identify gaps and improve services.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la TB e lokela ho hlahlojoa ka mehla ho tseba maqeba le ho ntlafatsa litshebeletso.

english_text: Supervision and mentoring of healthcare workers improves TB programme quality.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloja le ho ruta basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ho ntlafatsa boleng ba lenaneo la TB.

english_text: Integrated TB and primary healthcare services reduce patient travel and improve access.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tse kopaneng tsa TB le tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ea motheo li fokotsa ho tsamaea ha bakuli le ho ntlafatsa phihlello.

english_text: Decentralised TB services bring diagnosis and treatment closer to patients' homes.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa TB tse abeloang li tlisa tlhahlobo le phekolo haufi le malapa a bakuli.

english_text: Adequate drug supply management prevents TB medicine stockouts.
sesotho_text: Taolo e lekaneng ea phano ea meriana e thibela ho fela ha meriana ea TB.

english_text: Laboratory quality assurance ensures accurate and reliable TB test results.
sesotho_text: Netefatso ea boleng ba laboratori e netefatsa liphetho tsa liteko tsa TB tse nepahetseng le tse tšepahalang.

english_text: TB programme reviews help identify best practices that can be scaled up nationally.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa lenaneo la TB li thusa ho tseba mekhoa e metle e ka atolosoang naheng yohle.

english_text: Civil society organisations play a vital role in TB advocacy and community mobilisation.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo ea sechaba sa baahi e bua karolo ea bohlokoa ho boipiletso ba TB le ho matlafatsa sechaba.

english_text: Multisectoral action involving health, education, and social welfare is needed to end TB.
sesotho_text: Meketso ea likarolo tse ngata e kenyelletsa bophelo bo botle, thuto, le tšireletso ea sechaba e hlokeha ho felisa TB.

english_text: Know the symptoms of TB — cough, fever, night sweats, and weight loss — and seek care early.
sesotho_text: Tseba matšoao a TB — ho kohoa, feberu, molapo oa bosiu, le ho lahleheloa ke boima — mme batla tlhokomelo kapele.

english_text: TB is curable — do not give up on your treatment.
sesotho_text: TB e ka folisoa — u se ke ua tlohela phekolo ea hau.

english_text: Talking openly about TB in your community helps reduce fear and stigma.
sesotho_text: Ho bua ka bokhutšoanyane ka TB sechabeng sa hau ho thusa ho fokotsa tšabo le kekello.

english_text: Share TB information with your family and neighbours to protect your community.
sesotho_text: Arolelana tsebo ea TB le lelapa la hau le baahisane ho sireletsa sechaba sa hau.

english_text: TB affects everyone — rich and poor, young and old.
sesotho_text: TB e angoa bohle — bafumi le bafutsana, bacha le ba baholo.

english_text: Together we can end tuberculosis by testing early, treating completely, and supporting each other.
sesotho_text: Hammoho re ka felisa tuberculosis ka ho lekoa kapele, ho phekola ka botlalo, le ho tshehetsa e mong le e mong.

english_text: If you have been coughing for more than two weeks, please visit your nearest clinic.
sesotho_text: Haeba u kohile nako e fetang libeke tse peli, ka kopo etela kliniki ea hau e haufi.

english_text: TB treatment is free, effective, and available near you.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea TB ha e lefisoe, e sebetsa, mme e fumaneha haufi le hau.

english_text: You are not alone — healthcare workers and community supporters are here to help you.
sesotho_text: Ha u mong — basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle le batshehetsi ba sechaba ba le mona ho u thusa.

english_text: Completing your TB treatment protects not only you but also your family and community.
sesotho_text: Ho phetela phekolo ea TB ea hau ho sireletsa eseng wena feela empa le lelapa la hau le sechaba.

english_text: Primary TB infection occurs when a person is first exposed to Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso ea pele ea TB e etsahala ha motho a hlahisoa Mycobacterium tuberculosis lekhetlo la pele.

english_text: Post-primary TB, also called reactivation TB, occurs when latent infection becomes active.
sesotho_text: TB ea ka mor'a ea pele, e bitsoa hape TB ea ho vuseletsa, e etsahala ha tšoaetso e patileng e sebetsa.

english_text: TB can reactivate decades after the initial infection.
sesotho_text: TB e ka vuseletsa lilemo tse mashome ka mor'a tšoaetso ea pele.

english_text: Immunosuppressive medications such as TNF inhibitors increase the risk of TB reactivation.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea ho laola tšireletso ea 'mele joalo ka li-inhibitor tsa TNF e eketsa kotsi ea ho vuseletsa ha TB.

english_text: Organ transplant recipients are at increased risk of TB due to immunosuppressive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho ba fumanang litho tse fetisitsoeng ba leng kotsing e eketsehileng ea TB ka lebaka la phekolo ea ho laola tšireletso ea 'mele.

english_text: TB can cause cavities in the lungs that are visible on chest X-ray.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka likhoba matšoafong tse bonahalang ho X-ray ea sefuba.

english_text: Calcified lymph nodes on chest X-ray may indicate previous TB infection that has healed.
sesotho_text: Li-lymph node tse nang le calcium ho X-ray ea sefuba li ka bontša tšoaetso ea TB ea pele e folileng.

english_text: Bronchiectasis can be a long-term complication of severe pulmonary tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Bronchiectasis e ka ba bothata ba nako e telele ba tuberculosis e matla ea matšoafo.

english_text: TB can cause scarring of the lungs that leads to chronic respiratory problems.
sesotho_text: TB e ka baka ho phatloha ha matšoafo ho lebisang ho mathata a ho hema a nako e telele.

english_text: Early treatment of TB prevents permanent lung damage and improves long-term health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho phekola TB kapele ho thibela kotsi ea matšoafo e sa foleng le ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bophelo bo botle ba nako e telele.

english_text: TB bacteria have a waxy cell wall that makes them resistant to many common antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Bakteria ea TB e na le lebota la lisele le nang le lesela le e etsang hore e khahlanong le li-antibiotic tse ngata tse tloaelehileng.

english_text: The slow growth rate of TB bacteria is one reason why treatment takes several months.
sesotho_text: Lebelo le lleha la ho hola ha bakteria ea TB ke lebaka le le leng la hore phekolo e nka likhoeli tse ngata.

english_text: TB bacteria can remain dormant in the body for years before becoming active.
sesotho_text: Bakteria ea TB e ka lula e robetse 'meleng ka lilemo pele e sebetsa.

english_text: A weakened immune system is the most common trigger for latent TB to become active.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea 'mele e fokolang ke senyehelo se tloaelehileng ka ho fetisisa sa TB e patileng ho sebetsa.

english_text: Granulomas are small clusters of immune cells that form around TB bacteria to contain them.
sesotho_text: Li-granuloma ke lihlopha tse nyenyane tsa lisele tsa tšireletso ea 'mele tse bopehang haufi le bakteria ea TB ho li laola.

english_text: When granulomas break down, TB bacteria can escape and cause active disease.
sesotho_text: Ha li-granuloma li senya, bakteria ea TB e ka baleha mme e bake bolwetse bo sebetsang.

english_text: TB bacteria can develop resistance when patients take irregular or incomplete doses.
sesotho_text: Bakteria ea TB e ka hlaha khakanyo ha bakuli ba nka li-dose tse sa tloaelehang kapa tse sa phethehang.

english_text: Sputum induction using hypertonic saline helps obtain samples from patients who cannot cough productively.
sesotho_text: Ho khothaletsa ho hlahisa mathe ka ho sebelisa hypertonic saline ho thusa ho fumana lisampole ho bakuli ba ke ke ba kohoa ka nepo.

english_text: Gastric lavage is used to collect TB samples from young children who swallow their sputum.
sesotho_text: Ho hlatsoa mpa ho sebelisoa ho kgotha lisampole tsa TB ho bana ba banyenyane ba metsoang mathe a bona.

english_text: Nasopharyngeal aspirates can be used to diagnose TB in infants and toddlers.
sesotho_text: Li-aspirate tsa nasopharyngeal li ka sebelisoa ho fumana TB ho bana ba banyenyane le ba qalang ho tsamaea.

english_text: String test capsules are a non-invasive way to collect TB samples from children.
sesotho_text: Li-capsule tsa tlhahlobo ea khoele ke tsela e sa keneng ka hare ea ho kgotha lisampole tsa TB ho bana.

english_text: Stool Xpert testing is a promising method for diagnosing TB in young children.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha Stool Xpert ke mokoa o tšepehang oa ho fumana TB ho bana ba banyenyane.

english_text: TB lymphadenitis presents as painless swollen lymph nodes that may discharge pus.
sesotho_text: TB lymphadenitis e bontšoa e le li-lymph node tse ruruhetse tse sa bohlokong tse ka ntšang botlolo.

english_text: Renal TB can cause blood in the urine, flank pain, and frequent urination.
sesotho_text: TB ea lipitso e ka baka mali morotong, mahloko a mahlakore, le ho morota hangata.

english_text: TB of the adrenal glands can cause Addison's disease and adrenal insufficiency.
sesotho_text: TB ea li-adrenal gland e ka baka bolwetse ba Addison le ho hloka tšebetso ea li-adrenal.

english_text: Ocular TB can affect any part of the eye and may cause vision loss if untreated.
sesotho_text: TB ea mahlo e ka angoa karolo efe kapa efe ea leihlo mme e ka baka ho lahleheloa ke pono haeba e sa phekoluoe.

english_text: Cutaneous TB presents as skin lesions and is a rare form of extrapulmonary disease.
sesotho_text: TB ea letlalo e bontšoa e le maqeba a letlalo mme ke mofuta o sa tloaelehang oa bolwetse ba kantle ho matšoafo.

english_text: TB peritonitis causes abdominal pain, swelling, and fever due to infection of the abdominal lining.
sesotho_text: TB peritonitis e baka mahloko a mpa, ho ruruha, le feberu ka lebaka la tšoaetso ea letlalo la mpa.

english_text: Paradoxical reactions during TB treatment occur when symptoms temporarily worsen after starting therapy.
sesotho_text: Likarabelo tsa paradoxical nakong ea phekolo ea TB li etsahala ha matšoao a mpe ka nakoana ka mor'a ho qala phekolo.

english_text: Drug-induced hepatitis from TB medicines requires temporary suspension of treatment.
sesotho_text: Hepatitis e bakoang ke meriana ea TB e hloka ho emisa phekolo ka nakoana.

english_text: Therapeutic drug monitoring measures drug levels in the blood to optimise TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloja meriana ea phekolo ho lekola maemo a meriana maline ho ntlafatsa phekolo ea TB.

english_text: Population-based TB prevalence surveys measure the true burden of TB in a country.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa palo ea TB tse thehiloeng holim'a sechaba li lekola morwalo wa nnete oa TB naheng.

english_text: Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a rare but severe skin reaction to some TB medicines.
sesotho_text: Stevens-Johnson syndrome ke karabelo ea letlalo e sa tloaelehang empa e matla ho meriana e meng ea TB.
